newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tenders for 25,000 tonnes of sugar.

DHAKA, June 4 (Reuter) - Bangladesh's state-owned Sugar and Food Corporation has called bidding for 25,000 tonnes of white sugar for shipment by August 8, corporation officials said on Wednesday. They said the bidding would take place on June 8. The first cargo of 12,500 tonnes should reach Bangladesh by July 24, they said. The officials said the corporation was also expected to call bidding for another 25,000 tonnes of sugar by the end of June.
